blurb: Zurichess Neuchâtel is the September 2017 stable release of Alexandru Moșoi's BSD-licensed Go chess engine and library, whose versions are named alphabetically after Swiss cantons. It pairs fancy magic bitboards and a classical tapered evaluation tuned with Texel's method and TensorFlow with fail-soft PVS, SEE-guided late move reductions and leaf pruning, razoring, and countermove ordering. Adapted to UCI over WASI using Go's wasip1/wasm target and the Go poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded Go wasip1/wasm build running the search on the UCI goroutine via the Go poll helper; Hash capped at 1024 MB for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Fancy Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Fancy 64-bit magic bitboards with De Bruijn bitscan serialization.

features.label: Fail-Soft PVS
features.implementation: Fail-soft negamax PVS with iterative deepening, aspiration windows, and mate-distance pruning.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Reduced-depth null-move pruning at non-PV nodes.

features.label: SEE-Based LMR
features.implementation: Late move reductions incorporating static exchange evaluation (SEE) and move depth.

features.label: Futility & Leaf Pruning
features.implementation: Frontier futility pruning combined with SEE-based and history-based leaf pruning.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Depth-1 razoring dropping weak positions directly into quiescence search.

features.label: Check Extensions
features.implementation: One-ply search extension when the side to move is in check.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Capture search with transposition table probing and SEE pruning of losing captures.

features.label: Countermove & History
features.implementation: Countermove heuristic, killers, MVV-LVA, and an approximate-LRU hashed history table.

features.label: Pawn Cache
features.implementation: Cached pawn-structure evaluation covering connected, isolated, doubled, passed, and rammed pawns plus pawn shelter.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Automated-tuned middlegame/endgame evaluation with material, PSQTs, mobility, attacks, and open-file rooks.

features.label: King Safety
features.implementation: Toga-style king-zone attack evaluation combined with pawn shield and king-queen tropism.
